node.title: Luxury Recommendation
node.reading:
Industrial Case · Luxury Operations · Recommendation Systems · Vector Databases · SLM Architecture · Enterprise Data

In a high-end luxury group, a recommendation engine cannot be treated as a small add-on inside SAP, Salesforce or any single application.

The problem is not merely to search for products or to show “people who bought X also bought Y”. Recommendation in this context means connecting, in real time and with high precision:

Product and reference, client and household, purchase history, repair and after-sales history, style, aesthetics and cultural context.

Events, invitations, scarcity, boutique, region, channel, collection logic, design narratives, technical documentation and training content.

relations: The semantic-window lineage suggests testing contextual admissibility separately from similarity in product retrieval.
Los factores financieros no se convierten directamente en embeddings de lujo. La similitud semántica y la validez comercial requieren pruebas distintas.
Regional transfer works best when the reusable capability is separated from the channel that first hosted it.
El caso chino describe transferencia regional; no prueba portabilidad universal de miniapps ni de datos de clientes.
Semantic-window testing could examine when historical product context ceases to be admissible after a material change.
Regime awareness no es forecast ni un remedio general al concept drift. Definir qué cambio invalida qué inferencia antes de medir.
Similarity can help retrieve product knowledge, but currency, evidential scope and authority must be qualified separately before it supports an operational commitment.
Una recomendación comercial no equivale a una decisión crítica EA; aplicar sólo a los campos que realmente causen un compromiso.
